evals.name: explicit-architect-request
evals.prompt: Pull the requirements from our SpecLive workspace for Acme Logistics and propose an architecture that meets them. The API is running on http://localhost:8000.
evals.expected_output: A context pack + an architecture.md that satisfies the confirmed objectives/constraints, flags candidate requirements as assumptions, cites requirement IDs, and includes a C4/mermaid view and ADR-style decisions.

evals.name: implicit-workspace-resolution
evals.prompt: We just wrapped discovery for the warehouse modernization project. Can you architect the system we should build? Everything's in SpecLive, running locally on port 8000.
evals.expected_output: Skill resolves the single workspace (acme-logistics) without being given an id, pulls context, and produces the context pack + architecture doc traced to requirement IDs.

evals.name: trust-discipline-emphasis
evals.prompt: Design an architecture for the acme-logistics workspace (SpecLive is on localhost:8000), but be clear about what's actually confirmed versus still just assumptions — I don't want to commit to things the customer hasn't signed off on.
evals.expected_output: Architecture that separates FIRM (customer_confirmed/baselined) items it commits to from TENTATIVE items carried as explicit assumptions, and is honest that the functional requirements are still candidates.
